honeywell aerospace led an alliance of 18 european companies that made a breakthrough developing a megawatt-class hydrogen-electric propulsion system for future aircraft.

on 17 september 2026, under project newborn, the consortium successfully integrated individual subsystems into a functional hydrogen power source capable of generating and supplying electrical energy for an aircraft.

project newborn involves 18 companies from 10 european countries, including powercell, fraunhofer, test-fuchs, siemens industry software, ku leuven, friedrich-alexander-universität erlangen-nürnberg and cira.
the hydrogen power source system will be transferred to gorizia, italy, for final tests that will bring together dozens of technologies developed across europe into a single functional unit.
